<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
sol = ['RIGHT','DOWN','DOWN','RIGHT','UP','RIGHT','DOWN','DOWN','LEFT','LEFT','DOWN','RIGHT','RIGHT','DOWN','RIGHT','UP','RIGHT','DOWN']
def player(fr):
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b':
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            return (min(rs),min(cs))
print('before', player(current_frame))
res = action(sol, intent='solve')
print('after', player(current_frame))
print({k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','gameplay_changed','no_impact','level_completed','done','game_over','run_complete')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
